pg_stat_statements.query:
SELECT documents.id, documents.workspace_id, documents.name, documents.revision, documents.data, documents.updated_at 
FROM documents 
WHERE documents.workspace_id = $1::UUID ORDER BY documents.updated_at DESC 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER

SELECT jobs.id, jobs.workspace_id, jobs.document_id, jobs.parent_id, jobs.generation_request_id, jobs.kind, jobs.status, jobs.params, jobs.progress, jobs.message, jobs.error, jobs.error_code, jobs.recovery, jobs.external_task_id, jobs.attempt_count, jobs.state_version, jobs.execution_epoch, jobs.phase, jobs.lease_owner, jobs.lease_until, jobs.dispatched_until, jobs.reconcile_deadline, jobs.queue_deadline, jobs.execution_deadline, jobs.download_deadline, jobs.cancel_requested_at, jobs.phase_failures, jobs.provider_snapshot, jobs.phase_payload, jobs.next_poll_at, jobs.slot_scope, jobs.slot_acquired_at, jobs.created_at, jobs.updated_at, jobs.finished_at 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.parent_id = $1::UUID ORDER BY jobs.created_at, jobs.id

SELECT jobs.status, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.kind != $1::VARCHAR GROUP BY jobs.status

SELECT coalesce(sum(jobs.phase_failures), $1::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 
FROM jobs

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.slot_scope IS NOT NULL

SELECT documents.id AS documents_id, documents.workspace_id AS documents_workspace_id, documents.name AS documents_name, documents.revision AS documents_revision, documents.data AS documents_data, documents.updated_at AS documents_updated_at 
FROM documents 
WHERE documents.id = $1::UUID

SELECT outbox.status, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM outbox GROUP BY outbox.status

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.error_code LIKE $1::VARCHAR

SELECT jobs.id, jobs.workspace_id, jobs.document_id, jobs.parent_id, jobs.generation_request_id, jobs.kind, jobs.status, jobs.params, jobs.progress, jobs.message, jobs.error, jobs.error_code, jobs.recovery, jobs.external_task_id, jobs.attempt_count, jobs.state_version, jobs.execution_epoch, jobs.phase, jobs.lease_owner, jobs.lease_until, jobs.dispatched_until, jobs.reconcile_deadline, jobs.queue_deadline, jobs.execution_deadline, jobs.download_deadline, jobs.cancel_requested_at, jobs.phase_failures, jobs.provider_snapshot, jobs.phase_payload, jobs.next_poll_at, jobs.slot_scope, jobs.slot_acquired_at, jobs.created_at, jobs.updated_at, jobs.finished_at 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.workspace_id = $1::UUID AND jobs.parent_id IS NULL AND jobs.status IN ($2::VARCHAR, $3::VARCHAR) ORDER BY jobs.created_at DESC 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER

SELECT workspace_members.workspace_id, workspace_members.principal_id, workspace_members.role 
FROM workspace_members 
WHERE workspace_members.principal_id = $1::VARCHAR ORDER BY workspace_members.workspace_id 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER

SELECT browser_sessions.token_hash AS browser_sessions_token_hash, browser_sessions.principal_id AS browser_sessions_principal_id, browser_sessions.csrf_hash AS browser_sessions_csrf_hash, browser_sessions.expires_at AS browser_sessions_expires_at 
FROM browser_sessions 
WHERE browser_sessions.token_hash = $1::VARCHAR

SELECT jobs.id AS jobs_id, jobs.workspace_id AS jobs_workspace_id, jobs.document_id AS jobs_document_id, jobs.parent_id AS jobs_parent_id, jobs.generation_request_id AS jobs_generation_request_id, jobs.kind AS jobs_kind, jobs.status AS jobs_status, jobs.params AS jobs_params, jobs.progress AS jobs_progress, jobs.message AS jobs_message, jobs.error AS jobs_error, jobs.error_code AS jobs_error_code, jobs.recovery AS jobs_recovery, jobs.external_task_id AS jobs_external_task_id, jobs.attempt_count AS jobs_attempt_count, jobs.state_version AS jobs_state_version, jobs.execution_epoch AS jobs_execution_epoch, jobs.phase AS jobs_phase, jobs.lease_owner AS jobs_lease_owner, jobs.lease_until AS jobs_lease_until, jobs.dispatched_until AS jobs_dispatched_until, jobs.reconcile_deadline AS jobs_reconcile_deadline, jobs.queue_deadline AS jobs_queue_deadline, jobs.execution_deadline AS jobs_execution_deadline, jobs.download_deadline AS jobs_download_deadline, jobs.cancel_requested_at AS jobs_cancel_requested_at, jobs.phase_failures AS jobs_phase_failures, jobs.provider_snapshot AS jobs_provider_snapshot, jobs.phase_payload AS jobs_phase_payload, jobs.next_poll_at AS jobs_next_poll_at, jobs.slot_scope AS jobs_slot_scope, jobs.slot_acquired_at AS jobs_slot_acquired_at, jobs.created_at AS jobs_created_at, jobs.updated_at AS jobs_updated_at, jobs.finished_at AS jobs_finished_at 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.id = $1::UUID

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.lease_until < now()

SELECT generation_requests.id, generation_requests.workspace_id, generation_requests.request_id, generation_requests.request_hash, generation_requests.params, generation_requests.job_id, generation_requests.created_at 
FROM generation_requests 
WHERE generation_requests.workspace_id = $1::UUID AND generation_requests.request_id = $2::VARCHAR

SELECT jobs.id, jobs.workspace_id, jobs.document_id, jobs.parent_id, jobs.generation_request_id, jobs.kind, jobs.status, jobs.params, jobs.progress, jobs.message, jobs.error, jobs.error_code, jobs.recovery, jobs.external_task_id, jobs.attempt_count, jobs.state_version, jobs.execution_epoch, jobs.phase, jobs.lease_owner, jobs.lease_until, jobs.dispatched_until, jobs.reconcile_deadline, jobs.queue_deadline, jobs.execution_deadline, jobs.download_deadline, jobs.cancel_requested_at, jobs.phase_failures, jobs.provider_snapshot, jobs.phase_payload, jobs.next_poll_at, jobs.slot_scope, jobs.slot_acquired_at, jobs.created_at, jobs.updated_at, jobs.finished_at 
FROM jobs 
WHERE jobs.workspace_id = $1::UUID AND jobs.parent_id IS NULL AND jobs.status IN ($2::VARCHAR, $3::VARCHAR, $4::VARCHAR) ORDER BY jobs.created_at DESC

SELECT min(outbox.created_at) AS min_1 
FROM outbox 
WHERE outbox.status IN ($1::VARCHAR, $2::VARCHAR)
